sentences.text: Learned APP for the State filed a detailed counter affidavit in the present case.
Let it be kept on the record.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and learned APP for the State.
The petitioners are apprehending their arrest in a case registered for the offence punishable under Sections 406, 409 and 420/34 of the Indian Penal Code pending in the learned court below.
As per the prosecution case, after hatching conspiracy, the accused/petitioners have mis-appropriated the Government money.
Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.1022 of 2023(4) dt.21-04-2023
Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the petitioners are innocent and have been falsely implicated in this case.
He submits that there is no specific overt act against the petitioners.
He further submits that there is specific overt act against the Ajay Mandal.
He submit sthat there is no material available to establish the allegations of the informant against the petitioners.
